final: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT s.zoneref, i.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS i ON i.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, i.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio) AS average_group_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_size_per_minute) AS average_group_size_per_minute FROM group_avgs
